summary: A community giveaway shared on X, not verified by freetokens. Ben Newell (@ben_ai_eng) wrote on 2026-11-17: "I have 10 codes to give away, each covering one month of Devin Max ($200 value each)." He says: "I'll pick 10 builders based on a clear goal and how they'd use the month." Terms quoted from the post: "These codes are for the Devin Max subscription. One month per person. Payment card required to redeem. Entries close Friday November 20." The post gives no time zone.
claim_steps: Open the post by @ben_ai_eng on X: https://x.com/ben_ai_eng/status/2122616807404052781
Reply to it with, in the post's words: "What you're building", "How Devin would help" and "What you'd aim to ship in a month".
Optional, per the post: "Demos, screenshots, repos, or an idea you're ready to start would be a nice touch".
Reply before entries close: "Entries close Friday November 20." The post gives no time zone.
Winners are picked by the poster: "I'll pick 10 builders based on a clear goal and how they'd use the month."
A winning code is "for the Devin Max subscription. One month per person. Payment card required to redeem."
